inheritance: Orientation, display, phyllary/spine, stickiness, trait-completion priorities, three-discrete-module H2/H3 resolution, and the paired current-abiotic gate are inherited from v3 unless overridden below.

colour.global_exact_concept_bridge: 14/38 exact Japan38 taxon concepts have continuous image-derived colour metrics. The high-depth phylogenetic signal uses six exact concepts at n>=5 and five at n>=10.
colour.global_species_proxy_result: LAB lightness is anti-phylogenetic at high evidence depth in the global exact-concept proxy: n>=5 rho=-0.7071, exact two-sided p=0.04444; n>=10 rho=-0.8545, exact two-sided p=0.00833.

geographic_provenance_gate.operational_japan_window: Transparent three-box coordinate sensitivity, not an authoritative country polygon.
geographic_provenance_gate.decision: The anti-phylogenetic lightness pattern is not reproduced as a Japan-local radiation signal. Current evidence supports a global exact-concept species proxy only.

colour.paired_current_abiotic_gate: Same-cohort current climate/topography remains negative and soil remains coverage-limited, but mechanism expansion is now secondary to resolving Japan-local colour provenance.
colour.status: GLOBAL species-level lightness signal present; JAPAN-LOCAL radiation colour history not ready. Do not use global species medians as phenotypes of the Japanese nuclear-tip populations.

priority_reordering.first: Recover Japan-local colour evidence for JPN_29 C. verutum and JPN_38 C. pendulum, and improve population-matched Japan-local colour coverage for JPN_37 C. kamtschaticum.
priority_reordering.second: Re-run continuous lightness history on Japan-local population proxies with at least five identity-resolved concepts; propagate topology uncertainty only after this geographic gate passes.
priority_reordering.third: Only then expand same-population mechanism screens to radiation/rsds, VPD/aridity, wind/sfcWind and better soil coverage; historical climate and biotic interactions follow.
priority_reordering.discrete_colour: Do not invent a C/W threshold. Fixed-white lineage recovery and a biologically justified state ontology remain required for directional loss/regain questions.

cross_module.simple_common_lability_H3: not supported by the current three discrete historical modules
cross_module.colour_role: Colour currently constrains evidence quality and mechanism design as a continuous global species proxy; it is not yet a valid Japan-local historical module.

claim_boundary: The current continuous colour result is an exact-taxonomy global species-level proxy, not a population-matched Japan38 trait history. Exact name identity does not establish geographic/population identity. The operational Japan window is a coordinate heuristic; the negative local sensitivity blocks promotion to a Japan-local radiation claim but does not invalidate the global species-level signal.
